_optional_fields_note: The fields below are OPTIONAL. Remove the leading underscore to activate one — e.g. rename _STORE_ID to STORE_ID and set its value. Fields left with an underscore (or deleted) are NOT touched in src/config/constants.js.
_STORE_ID_note: STORE_ID stays deactivated on purpose for DLJ — it's a real Jewellery ERP tenant carrying the STRING Tenant_ID "DLJ" (see savingsAppCore.js), not a legacy numeric Store_ID. This script's STORE_ID transform only matches a numeric value and would either abort the whole run or overwrite that string with a number — leave it untouched here and keep editing it by hand in constants.js if it ever needs to change.
